description: Defines synchronization primitives including a mutex wrapper class (QuicheLockImpl) and a notification class (QuicheNotificationImpl) for the quiche networking library, with platform-specific macros and includes.

classes.name: QuicheLockImpl
classes.description: A class wrapping a non-reentrant mutex with methods for writer and reader locks, and unlocks.

classes.name: QuicheNotificationImpl
classes.description: A class providing thread notification capabilities via a waitable event.

methods.name: WriterLock()
methods.description: Acquires the lock exclusively, blocking until available.

methods.name: ReaderLock()
methods.description: Acquires a shared lock, blocking until available.

methods.name: AssertReaderHeld()
methods.description: Checks if a shared lock is held; not implemented.

methods.name: HasBeenNotified()
methods.description: Checks if the event has been signaled.

methods.name: Notify()
methods.description: Signals the event to notify waiting threads.

methods.name: WaitForNotification()
methods.description: Blocks until the event is signaled.
